problem: State says RUNNING but process died after producing an artifact
wrong_pattern: Restart task from zero or assume DONE
cause: Checkpoint and real artifact state diverged
correct_method: resume only from last verified boundary
verification: No side effect is repeated and state matches verified artifacts

problem: Recovery would resume using invalid context
wrong_pattern: Trust checkpoint solely because it is newest
cause: Checkpoint freshness not compared with source hashes
correct_method: compare stored hashes with current sources
verification: Resume is blocked until stale references are reconciled

problem: No test output or runtime evidence accompanies DONE claim
cause: Generator is acting as its own verifier
verification: Sheriff emits BLOCK/FAIL until external evidence is attached

trigger: All unit tests pass but production dependency is unreachable
problem: Local tests alone would incorrectly certify full feature readiness
cause: Acceptance level is broader than test scope
correct_method: map evidence level to acceptance criterion
keep feature UNKNOWN/BLOCKED for untested external dependency
verification: Feature PASS requires evidence at the acceptance scope
